title: Error envelope (every non-2xx response)
description: Codes per endpoint are listed in endpoints.json (errors, plus common_errors on every signed endpoint). Status classes: 400 bad grant, 401 authentication (timestamp_skew carries server_time), 403 not allowed for this shopper or account (verification_required: the customer's phone is not verified for this outlet), 404 unknown or cross-organisation id, 409 conflict (points_insufficient carries available, credits_insufficient carries available_cents, voucher_unavailable), 410 spent or unknown sso_ticket (ticket_invalid), 422 business rejection (otp_invalid, otp_expired, otp_attempts_exceeded, discount_mismatch; validation_failed carries errors), 429 throttled with Retry-After (otp_throttled).

examples.message: The request timestamp is outside the allowed window.
